summary: Iteration 9 - Phase 1 AstrologyAPI Integration Testing Complete. 20/20 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend tests verified Phase Lunaire section on /quotidien page with French text. All new features working: moon-phase endpoint, daily content enrichment with moon phase, pro-horoscope PDF with real SVG natal chart.
passed_tests: GET /api/moon-phase returns French phase name (e.g., 'Lune Gibbeuse')
Daily endpoint still returns all standard horoscope fields
POST /api/pdf/pro-horoscope PDF size > 1MB (enriched with SVG chart)
POST /api/pdf/pro-horoscope PDF contains natal chart page content
Regression: POST /api/discount/validate with PLUME2026 still works
Frontend: Phase Lunaire section displays with data-testid='phase-lunaire'
Frontend: Phase Lunaire shows French text ('Lune Gibbeuse')
Frontend: Phase Lunaire shows conseil text
Frontend: All other sections visible (phrase-du-jour, energie-jour, conseil-jour, horoscope-detail)
critical_code_review_comments: Moon phase endpoint correctly calls AstrologyAPI moon_phase_report and translates to French
Daily endpoint enriches content with phase_lunaire including French phase name and conseil
PDF generator correctly integrates SVG natal chart from AstrologyAPI via cairosvg conversion
Frontend Quotidien.js properly displays Phase Lunaire section with data-testid='phase-lunaire'
All French translations are hardcoded in server.py moon_phases_fr and moon_conseils_fr dictionaries
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 9 tested Phase 1 AstrologyAPI integrations. Key findings: 1) GET /api/moon-phase returns French phase name, conseil, and signification from moon_phase_report API, 2) GET /api/daily/{sign} enriches response with phase_lunaire object containing French-translated moon data, 3) POST /api/pdf/pro-horoscope generates PDF with real SVG natal chart from natal_wheel_chart API endpoint (converted via cairosvg), 4) Frontend /quotidien shows Phase Lunaire section with data-testid='phase-lunaire' displaying French text. Test file: /app/backend/tests/test_phase1_astrology_api.py
